scope: Exit confirmation buttons only. Save and exit after success; discard exits immediately without invoking save.

results.name: discard exits immediately once without saving
save waits pending then exits on success
false save retains editor and denial message
actual save catches rejected account save and stays editor
Escape dismisses only and keeps editor

browserChecks.limits: Actual native browser dialog with exact extracted production handlers and save function; fixture account saving/allowOutput and snapshot, no live account/network writes, no physical iOS device.
